k-12.title: Ndiani ari kuzviita? Misoro yemitsara yakasiiwa
k-12.goal: Tsvaga kuti ndiani anoreva muchat umo misoro yemitsara yakasiiwa, tsvaga mutsara unoramba usina kujeka, uye unyore chat yako pfupi umo chiratidzo chichiratidza kuti ndiani.
k-12.material:
수미 ne 태호 vanoshanda muhofisi imwechete. Vari kuedza kusvika kuna 부장님 wavo (musoro wedhipatimendi). 비서 zvinoreva munyori wemusoro.

수미: 부장님한테 전화했어요?
태호: 네, 했는데 안 받으세요.
수미: 비서한테는 물어봤어요?
태호: 네, 물어봤더니 지금 회의 중이시래요.
k-12.thinking.0: Kufungidzira misoro yemitsara yakasiiwa kubva pakupera kunoremekedza
k-12.s.s1.prompt: Mumutsara wekupedzisira waTaeho (태호), ndiani ari musangano?
k-12.s.s1.r.c: 수미 haasi munhu anotaurwa; kupera kunoremekedza kunoratidzawo munhu ari pamusoro.
k-12.s.s1.r.d: Munyori ndiye akapindura, kwete munhu ari musangano.
k-12.s.s1.explain: '회의 중이시래요' ine -시- inoremekedza, inoratidza musoro wemutsara semunhu anofanira kukudzwa: 부장님.
k-12.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga kuti 태호 akabvunza ani mumutsara wapfuura.
k-12.s.s2.r.b: 태호 akabvunza munyori, kwete musoro, uye musoro ndiye ari kushanda musangano.
k-12.s.s2.r.c: 수미 ndiye ari kubvunza, kwete akapindura.
k-12.s.s2.explain: '물어봤더니 ... -래요' = 'pandakabvunza, (vakati) kuti ...'. Munhu akabvunzwa mumutsara wapfuura i 비서.
k-12.s.s3.prompt: Muchimwe chat, mutsara mumwe usingajekesi kuti ndiani anoreva, kunyangwe chiito chichikudza, nekuti vanhu vaviri vanokudzwa vari muhurukuro. Chisarudze.
k-12.s.s3.hint.1: Mumutsara mumwe nemumwe, bvunza kana musoro wemutsara wakatsanangurwa kana kuti ungangofungidzirwa.
k-12.s.s3.explain: '연락하신대요' ine -시-, saka munhu anokudzwa, asi zvose 사장님 ne 팀장님 vanokodzera uye mitsara yakamberi inovataura pamwe chete. Muverengi haagone kuziva kuti ndiani achadaidza zvakare; kuwedzera musoro wemutsara ('사장님이 ...' kana '팀장님이 ...') kunogadzirisa.
k-12.s.s4.prompt: Gadzira chat yako yemitsara miviri muKorea (kutaura kunoremekedza) kubva pamamiriro ekuchikoro kana ebasa: mumwe anobvunza kuti mudzidzisi kana mukuru akataura kana kuita chii, uye mhinduro inosiya musoro wemutsara asi kupera kunoremekedza kuchiratidza kuti ndiani.
k-12.s.s4.hint.0: Sarudza munhu anofanira kukudzwa, sa 선생님 kana 부장님.
k-12.s.s4.hint.1: Bvunza ne 뭐라고 하셨어요? kana 오셨어요?
k-12.s.s4.selfAssess.0: Muverengi anogona kuziva kuti ndiani akazviita pasina musoro wemutsara here?
k-12.s.s4.selfAssess.1: Ndakashandisa kukudza kumunhu anofanira bedzi here?
k-12.s.s4.modelNote.1: Zviito zvinokudza mumhinduro; musoro wemutsara wakasiiwa.

k-01.title: 'Kwete' risingatauri kwete
k-01.goal: Fungidzira kubva pachat pfupi kuti mhinduro yakanyorovesa inoramba zuva rimwe asi kwete chirongwa chose, taura humbowo, uye unyore kurambira kwako kunyoro nesarudzo.
k-01.material:
Vadzidzi vaviri veboka, 민수 ne수진, vanotumirana mameseji. Vanoshandisa kutaura kwe -요 kune hunhu kuno mumwe nomumwe. (😅 = chiso chine dutu diki rehutsi, kunyemwerera kusina kunaka.)

민수: 토요일에 영화 볼까요?
수진: 토요일은 좀… 😅
민수: 그럼 일요일은요?
수진: 일요일은 좋아요!
k-01.prereq.1: Unoziva mapendero akapfava -아요/어요 nemazwi emazuva evhiki
k-01.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga mutsara unotevera wa민수: anoita sei?
k-01.s.s1.hint.1: Cherekedza kuti 수진 haambotaura 네 kana 아니요. Chii chaasina kupedzisa?
k-01.s.s1.o.a: Satidha harina kunaka kwaari; ari kuramba zuva iroro.
k-01.s.s1.o.b: Satidha rakanaka zvikuru kwaari uye akafara.
k-01.s.s1.r.b: '좀…' inobva yaneta ine emoji inonyadzisa kunonoka, kwete mufaro. Tarisa kuti mutsara unotevera (그럼 일요일은요?) unopindura sei.
k-01.s.s1.r.c: Izvi zvinoverenga zvakanyanya. Mutsara wake wekupedzisira, 일요일은 좋아요!, unoratidza kuti achiri kuda kuenda.
k-01.s.s1.r.d: Anopindura mubvunzo zvakananga nekutaura zuva, saka akanzwisisa.
k-01.s.s1.explain: '좀…' inonyorodza kuramba kuti hapana anofanira kuti '안 돼요'. Maka e topic -은 mu '토요일은' anosiyanisa Satidha, uye 민수 anopindura nekupa rimwe zuva.
k-01.s.s2.prompt: Humbowo hupi hunoratidza kuti 수진 achiri kuda kuona firimu? Sarudza hwese hunoshanda.
k-01.s.s2.hint.0: Tsvaga mitsara umo anotaura chinhu chakanaka.
k-01.s.s2.hint.1: Enzanisa zvaanotaura mu '토요일은 좀…' nezvaanotaura mu '일요일은 좋아요!'.
k-01.s.s2.o.a: Anopindura '일요일은 좋아요!' kana 민수 achipa Svondo.
k-01.s.s2.r.b: '좀' inonyorodza kuramba; haitaure kuti anofarira hurongwa here.
k-01.s.s2.r.c: Emoji inoratidza kuti anonyadziswa, kwete kuti anoda firimu.
k-01.s.s2.o.d: Akati '토요일은', achitaura zuva chete, kwete firimu pachayo.
k-01.s.s2.explain: Haarambi firimu. Anongoramba Satidha (토요일은), uye anogamuchira Svondo.
k-01.s.s2.acc.0: Kutaura humbowo hwakajeka chete (anogamuchira Svondo) kunonzwisisika; d inowedzera kuti anotaura zuva chete, kwete firimu.
k-01.s.s3.prompt: Mudzidzi mukirasi yako 민수 anokukoka kuti mudye kunze paSatidha, asi iwe haugone kuenda. Pindura muchiKorea nemutauro we 요: usati '싫어요', nyorodza kuramba, uye ukurudzire rimwe zuva.
k-01.s.s3.hint.0: Tanga nekuti ndine ushungu kana kuti zvinosuruvarisa, wobva wataura Satidha.
k-01.s.s3.hint.1: Taura ndine ushungu kana kupa chikonzero chipfupi, wobva wapedzisa nemubvunzo unokurudzira rimwe zuva.
k-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mhinduro yangu inoratidza zvakajeka kuti handigoni Satidha here?
k-01.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakachengeta ushamwari hwakadziya (kunyorodza, mamwe mazuva) here?
k-01.s.s3.modelNote.0: Pfupi uye yakapfava; inoshandisa 좀 uye inopa zuva.
k-01.s.s3.modelNote.1: Inopa chikonzero panzvimbo ye 좀, wobva wakurudzira Svondo.

k-02.title: Kutaura nemushandi wechitoro
k-02.goal: Cherekedza mitsara yemutengi ipi yakajairika zvakanyanya kumunhu usingazivi muchitoro, sarudza kuti nei, uye uinyore patsva nerukudzo.
k-02.material: Pachitoro chemichero. Mushandi nemutengi havazivani. Vose vanoita sevakuru.
k-02.s.s1.prompt: Mutsara mumwe kana mizhinji yemutengi inonzwika yakajairika zvakanyanya kutaura nemushandi wausingazivi. Sarudza mumwe wayo.
k-02.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa kupera kwemutsara mumwe nemumwe wemutengi: unopera ne -요/-습니다 here?
k-02.s.s1.explain: '얼마야?' ne '줘' ndeye 반말 (mutauro wakajairika). Vasingazivani vanowanzoshandisa mutauro une rukudzo kune mumwe: '얼마예요?' ne '주세요'.
k-02.s.s2.prompt: Mushandi anoshandisa mutauro une rukudzo (-요) kumutengi. Mutengi anogona kupindura nemutauro wakajairika (반말) nekuda kweizvozvo here?
k-02.s.s2.hint.1: Fungidzira mutengi musinganzwi pabhazi. Ungashandisa mwero wemutauro upi?
k-02.s.s2.o.a: Kwete. Vasingazivani vanoshandisa mutauro une rukudzo kune mumwe nemumwe; mushandi une rukudzo semubayiro webasa.
k-02.s.s2.o.b: Hongu. Vose vakuru vari kutaura, saka mutauro wakajairika wakanaka.
k-02.s.s2.r.b: Kuva vakuru hakuiti kuti mutauro wakajairika ukodzere; nemunhu usingazivi, chisarudzo chakachengeteka mutauro une rukudzo kune mumwe nemumwe.
k-02.s.s2.o.c: Hongu. Mutengi ari kubhadhara, saka mutengi ndiye anosarudza.
k-02.s.s2.r.c: Kubhadhara hakuchinji hukama. Vatengi vanowanzoshandisawo mutauro une rukudzo.
k-02.s.s2.o.d: Kwete, asi nokuti mushandi mukuru zvikuru.
k-02.s.s2.r.d: Zera rinogona kukosha, asi pano zera harina kupiwa. Chikonzero chikuru ndechekuti vasingazivani.
k-02.s.s2.explain: Chisarudzo pakati pevasingazivani mutauro une rukudzo kune mumwe nemumwe. Muzvitoro, mutauro une rukudzo wemushandi mutauro wekushumira uye hauti mutengi ane kodzero yekushandisa 반말.
k-02.s.s3.prompt: Nyora patsva mitsara miviri yakajairika yemutengi ('이 귤 얼마야?' ne '그럼 두 봉지 줘.') kuti ienderane nemamiriro aya.
k-02.s.s3.hint.0: Chinja mapendero emitsara yose miviri kuita chimiro une rukudzo.
k-02.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mitsara yangu yose miviri inopera nerukudzo here?

k-03.title: Nguva dzinoenderana here?
k-03.goal: Enzanisa ziviso pfupi nemeseji yeshamwari, cherekedza kuti nguva hadzienderani, uye ubvunze mubvunzo wakanaka wekujekesa panzvimbo yekubvuma.
k-03.material:
Nhasi ndi Chishanu, 10월 23일. Chikoro chako chine ziviso uye shamwari yako yakutumira meseji.

[소풍 안내]
- 날짜: 10월 24일 토요일
- 장소: 한강공원
- 버스 출발: 아침 8시 30분 (학교 앞)
- 준비물: 도시락, 물, 편한 신발

친구 문자: "내일 7시에 학교 앞에서 만나요! 도시락 꼭 가져와요."
k-03.s.s1.prompt: Usati wapindura, mubvunzo upi unobatsira zvikuru kubvunza shamwari yako?
k-03.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga nguva dzese muziviso nemumeseji, wobva waenzanisa.
k-03.s.s1.hint.1: Mubvunzo upi unobvunza chimwe chinhu CHISINGAZIVIKANWI neziviso?
k-03.s.s1.r.a: Ziviso yatoti nguva yebhazi, saka mubvunzo uyu haubvumi chinhu.
k-03.s.s1.r.c: Meseji inongoti uuye nebhokisi rechikafu; kwekutenga hakusi dambudziko.
k-03.s.s1.r.e: Kubvunza AM kana PM kungava danho rekutanga, asi bhazi rinobva mangwanani, saka musangano wemanheru hauna revo. Dambudziko chairo kusiyana kwenguva yebhazi nenguva yemusangano.
k-03.s.s1.explain: Masosi maviri akasiyana (ziviso inoti bhazi rinobva 8:30, meseji inoti musangane 7:00). Mubvunzo wakanakisa unonongedzera musiyano kuti shamwari itsanangure.
k-03.s.s1.acc.0: Kubvunza AM/PM kujekesa kwekutanga kunonzwisisika, asi hakuratidzi kuti wakacherekedza nguva yebhazi 8:30.
k-03.s.s2.prompt: Nyora mubvunzo wako kushamwari muchiKorea (mutauro we -요 une ushamwari). Taura zvose nguva yebhazi (kana ziviso) nemusangano we 7:00.
k-03.s.s2.hint.0: Isa nguva yebhazi nenguva yeshamwari yako padyo nepadyo mumutsara mumwe.
k-03.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Mubvunzo wangu unoratidza kuti ndakacherekedza kuti nguva mbiri dzakasiyana here?
k-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Shamwari yangu inogona kuupindura nemutsara mumwe pfupi here?

k-04.thinking.1: Kugutsa mamiriro akawanda panguva imwe chete
k-04.title: Kutenga nemiganhu
k-04.goal: Shandura meseji pfupi ine mazwi akasiiwa kuita miganhu chaiyo, tsvaga mabhasiketi akati wandei anosangana nawo, uye uzivise rimwe muchiKorea.
k-04.material:
Shamwari yako inokutumira meseji usati waenda kumusika:

"시장에 가요? 그럼 사과랑 귤 좀 사 와요. 만 원까지 쓸 수 있어요. 귤이 사과보다 많아야 해요. 모두 5봉지 이상이요."

[가격표]
사과 한 봉지: 2,000원
귤 한 봉지: 1,000원
k-04.prereq.2: Wakasangana ne -까지 (kusvika), -보다 (kupfuura) ne 이상 (nhamba iyi kana kupfuura); zvinotsanangurwa mumazano
k-04.s.s1.prompt: '만 원까지 쓸 수 있어요' inokuudza chii?
k-04.s.s1.hint.1: Bvunza kuti shamwari yaizofara here kana wakashandisa 8,000 won.
k-04.s.s1.o.a: Unogona kushandisa kusvika 10,000 won asi kwete kupfuura.
k-04.s.s1.r.c: Izvo zvaizova zvinopesana: mugumo mushoma panzvimbo yemuganhu wepamusoro.
k-04.s.s1.r.d: Mitengo iri murondedzero yemitengo; 만 원 imari yaunogona kushandisa.
k-04.s.s1.explain: '-까지' inoratidza muganhu wepamusoro: kusvika 10,000 won, uye kushandisa zvishoma zvakanaka.
k-04.s.s2.prompt: Tsvaga mabhasiketi 3 anokodzera mamiriro ese emumeseji, rimwe nerimwe rine huwandu hwakasiyana hwemabhegi emaapuro. a = mabhegi emaapuro, g = mabhegi ematangerine.
k-04.s.s2.hint.0: Nyora mamiriro kutanga nemazwi ako: '-보다 많아야 해요' = anofanira kupfuura; '이상' = nhamba iyi kana kupfuura.
k-04.s.s2.hint.1: Edza a = 1 uye uwedzere g kusvikira huwandu hwasvika mabhegi 5.
k-04.s.s2.hint.2: Tarisa mari yekupedzisira: 2,000 × a + 1,000 × g, wobva wachinja a.
k-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Meseji inokumbira zvose 사과 ne 귤 (bhegi rimwe zvishoma kune rimwe nerimwe).
k-04.s.s2.fail.c2: 귤이 사과보다 많아야 해요: mabhegi ematangerine anofanira kupfuura emaapuro.
k-04.s.s2.fail.c3: 모두 5봉지 이상: mabhegi 5 kana kupfuura pamwe chete.
k-04.s.s2.explain: Semuenzaniso 1 apuro + 4 matangerine = 6,000 won; 2 + 3 = 7,000 won; 3 + 4 = 10,000 won. Mabhasiketi mazhinji anokodzera nokuti meseji inopa miganhu, kwete odha imwe chaiyo.
k-04.s.s2.because.prompt: Sarudza rimwe BHASIKETI rako uye utumire shamwari yako meseji pfupi muchiKorea (-요 ine rukudzo) ichiti wakatenga mabhegi mangani emuchero mumwe nemumwe nehuwandu hwose.
k-04.s.s2.because.hint.0: Shandisa rimwe bhasiketi rakapfuura: nhamba dzipi mbiri?
k-04.s.s2.because.hint.1: Taura huwandu hwemaapuro, huwandu hwematangerine, wobva wataura huwandu hwose mu won.
k-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.0: Nhamba dziri mumeseji yangu dzinoenderana nebhasiketi rimwe randakagadzira here?
k-04.s.s2.because.selfAssess.1: Huwandu hwose hwakarurama here (2,000 × maapuro + 1,000 × matangerine)?

k-05.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza uchishandisa zvawaverenga kusvika zvino bedzi.
k-05.s.s1.prompt: Verenga chikamu chimwe nechimwe, sarudza kuverenga kunoratidzika kunogoneka zvikuru, wobva waenderera.
k-05.title: Muvakidzani anoreva chii?
k-05.goal: Gadzirisa kuverenga kwako kwenyunyuto isina kunangana sezvo nhaurirano yakawanda ichionekwa, wobva wanyora tsamba inokodzera kumuvakidzani.
k-05.material: Unogara muapartment 302. Munhu mukuru kubva paapartment 202 (pasi pako), wausingazivi zvakanyanya, anokumisa muelevator.
k-05.thinking.1: Kugadzirisa kududzira kana nhaurirano yakawanda yaonekwa
k-05.s.s1.hint.1: Tarisa mapendero emitsara (…, -서요, -는데) kuti uone zvisina kutaurwa.
k-05.s.s1.st.0.after: Panguva ino zvose kutaura zvidiki nekuratidza dambudziko zvinogoneka, asi '들려서요…' inopera nechikonzero uye inosiya mugumisiro usina kutaurwa, izvo kazhinji zvinoratidza nyunyuto.
k-05.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Hapana chiri mumutsara chinoratidza kutamira; muvakidzani aida izvozvo aizotaura zvakananga zvikuru.
k-05.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Hapana mutauro wekukoka (senge 놀러 오세요). Mutsara unotaura nezveruzha runonetsa mutauri.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.ask: Mwana ndewaani, uye muvakidzani anotarisira chii?
k-05.s.s1.st.1.after: Mutauri anodonhedza muridzi, asi mwana anomuka nokuda kweruzha rwuri pamusoro ndewemuvakidzani. Vanotarisira ruzha rushoma, kwete kuti iwe uende.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Mwana wavo pachavo; vanotarisira kuti ruzha rwemanheru ruderedzwe
k-05.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Mwana ndiye anomuka nokuda kwenzwi riri pamusoro, saka ndewemutauri, kwete wako.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.o.c: Mwana wavo pachavo; vanoda kuti utamise
k-05.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Tarisiro yemutauri iri pamusoro peruzha, kwete pazvaunogara; hapana chiratidzo chekuti vanoda kuti utamise.
k-05.s.s1.st.1.o.d: Hapana mwana wemunhu; kungotaura zvisina basa
k-05.s.s1.st.1.r.d: Zvakadzama nezvemwana (자는데, 깨서요) chikonzero chechikumbiro, saka izvi zvinopfuura kutaura zvisina basa.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.after: '아니에요, 감사해요' ne'좀 부탁드려요' zvinoratidza chikumbiro chakadzikama, chine mutsa chakamiswa mushure me9 p.m.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Haatsamwa; anogamuchira hurongwa hwako uye anokumbira runyararo mushure me9
k-05.s.s1.st.2.r.b: '아니에요, 감사해요' zwi rakadzikama, rekuonga, kwete rekutsamwa.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Anoda kuti vana varege kumhanya nguva dzose
k-05.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Anokumbira mushure me9 chete ('9시 이후만'), kwete kusamhanya nguva dzose.
k-05.s.s1.st.2.r.d: Achiti '부탁드려요', saka runyararo mushure me9 runokosha kwaari.
k-05.s.s1.reflect: Cherekedza kuti chichemo chinogona kuvakwa sei kubva pazviratidzo zvidiki: mutsara usina kupera kutanga, wobva wachikonzero, wobva wachikumbiro. Mutsa hauna kureva kuti hapana chikumbiro.
k-05.s.s2.prompt: Zuva rinotevera unosiya notsi pfupi (쪽지) pamusuo wemuvakidzani. Kumbira ruregerero, taura zvaunoita, uye uonge. Shandisa kutaura kwemutsa.
k-05.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga nenhamba yeapartment yako, wobva wakumbira ruregerero.
k-05.s.s2.hint.1: Taura nguva (sa 9시 이후) kana maitiro aunochinja.
k-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Chivimbiso changu chakajeka (nguva kana maitiro) here?
k-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ndaizonzwa zvakanaka muvakidzani dai andinyorera izvi here?

k-10.title: Chikumbiro ichi chakasimba zvakadii?
k-10.goal: Gadzirisa kuverenga kwako chikumbiro chakapfava chebasa apo mameseji akawanda anoonekwa, wobva wanyora mhinduro inosimbisa zvauchaita uye rini.
k-10.material: 팀장 yako (mutungamiriri weboka, mukuru wako) anokutumira mameseji muchat yekambani. Averenge imwe imwe.
k-10.s.s1.prompt: Verenga meseji imwe neimwe, sarudza kuti unonzwisisa sei, wobva waenderera.
k-10.s.s1.hint.0: Sarudza uchishandisa mameseji awakaona kusvika zvino bedzi.
k-10.s.s1.hint.1: Bvunza kuti ndiani ari kutaura kuna ani uye mukuru anowanzotarisira chii.
k-10.s.s1.st.0.after: Kubva kumukuru, '혹시 ... 주실 수 있을까요?' kazhinji i nzira inoremekedza yekukumbira kuti chinhu chiitwe. Kuiverenga sezvakanyorwa sembvunzo nezvenguva yako yemahara kunogoneka pakutanga, asi mameseji anotevera anoratidza kuti i chikumbiro chaicho.
k-10.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Chikumbiro chakapfava asi chaicho kubva kumukuru; unotarisirwa kuchiita
k-10.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Chikumbiro chemukuru kazhinji hachisi chekuzvisarudzira; mazwi akapfava (혹시, 시간 되면) anochengeta kuremekedza bedzi.
k-10.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Mubvunzo nezvekuti une nguva yemahara here
k-10.s.s1.st.0.r.d: Hapana izwi sa 지금 kana 당장 rinoonekwa, saka haisi murairo wepakarepo.
k-10.s.s1.st.1.after: '-까지만 보면 돼요' inomisa muganho: pamberi pemusangano wemangwana. '급한 건 아니고요' inongoreva kuti hapana dambudziko rekukurumidza.
k-10.s.s1.st.1.r.a: '내일 오전 회의 전까지만' inomisa muganho wakasimba kupfuura 'vhiki ino'.
k-10.s.s1.st.1.r.c: '급한 건 아니고요' inoti hakusi kukurumidza, saka hazvisi izvozvi.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.after: '더 좋고요' i chido, kwete mutemo, asi zvido zvemukuru zvinokosha. Ronga kutarisa nhasi kana kutarisa zvinyoro kuti chido chakasimba zvakadii.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Usaite chinhu kusvika mangwanani, nguva yekupedzisira i musangano
k-10.s.s1.st.2.r.a: Izvi zvinosangana nenguva yakataurwa asi zvinoregeredza chido chitsva chenhasi ('더 좋고요'); chido chemukuru kazhinji chinoverengwa.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Edza kuchitarisa usati wabva nhasi, uye upedze pamberi pemusangano
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Regeredza meseji itsva, nguva yekupedzisira yekutanga ndiyo chaiyo
k-10.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Meseji itsva inowedzera kune yekutanga; haiikanzure, uye chido chemukuru chinokosha.
k-10.s.s1.st.2.o.d: Pindura nekubvunza kana kutarisa nhasi kuchidiwa kana kungogamuchirwa
k-10.s.s1.reflect: Chikumbiro chakapfava chemukuru kazhinji chichitarisirwa kuti chiitwe. Mameseji gare gare kazhinji anowedzera nguva yekupedzisira chaiyo; mutsara wakapfava zvikuru haufanani ne 'kusarudza'.
k-10.s.s2.prompt: Pindura 팀장님 muchat nekutaura kunoremekedza. Simbisa kuti uchazviita uye utaure rini.
k-10.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Mutungamiriri weboka aizogutsikana nemhinduro iyi here?

k-06.title: Shamwari yangu inogona kuwana kudzorerwa mari here?
k-06.goal: Batanidza chizivisiro, tafura nemeseji yeshamwari kusarudza kudzorerwa mari kwakadii, taura humbowo hunodiwa, wobva wachitsanangurira shamwari muchiKorea.
k-06.s.s1.prompt: Shamwari yako inogona kuwana kudzorerwa mari kwakadii?
k-06.s.s1.hint.0: Verenga chikamu chimwe muzvitatu nehafu yemakirasi 8.
k-06.s.s1.hint.1: Enzanisa makirasi 3 eshamwari yako nenhamba mbiri idzi.
k-06.s.s1.r.a: Kudzorerwa mari kwakazara kunoshanda kosi isati yatanga chete. Shamwari yako yatopinda makirasi 3.
k-06.s.s1.r.b: Zvikamu zviviri muzvitatu zvinoshanda pamberi pokunge chikamu chimwe muzvitatu chemakirasi chapfuura. 3 pa8 inopfuura chikamu chimwe muzvitatu (inenge 2.7).
k-06.s.s1.r.d: Hapana kudzorerwa mari kunoshanda mushure mehafu (4 pa8) yapfuura chete. Shamwari yako ave nemakirasi 3 chete.
k-06.s.s1.explain: Makirasi 3 pa8 anopfuura chikamu chimwe muzvitatu (8 ÷ 3 ≈ 2.7) asi mashoma kupfuura hafu (4). Saka mutsara we 'before half has passed' unoshanda: kudzorerwa mari kwehafu.
k-06.s.s2.prompt: Zvidimbu zveruzivo zvipi zvawaida kuwana mhinduro iyi?
k-06.s.s2.o.c: Zvikumbiro zvinofanira kuitwa pazuva risina kirasi.
k-06.s.s2.r.c: Izvo zvinoti kuti utange sei chete, kwete kuti rudzorerwa marii.
k-06.s.s2.explain: Tafura inopa zvikamu zvekosi yose, saka unoda huwandu hwose (8) nenhamba yatopindwa (3). Kutanga sei nechikonzero hazvidiwi kuhuwandu.
k-06.s.s2.acc.0: Kuziva kutanga sei kunobatsira panhanho inotevera, asi hakuchinji huwandu hwekudzorerwa mari.
k-06.s.s3.prompt: Pindura shamwari yako muchiKorea: taura kudzorerwa mari kwakadii, ipa chikonzero kubva panhamba, uye mutaurire zvekuita zvinotevera. Kutaura kusina mutemo kana kwemutsa zvose zvakanaka.
k-06.s.s3.hint.0: Ipa mhinduro kutanga, wobva wapa chikonzero nenhamba.
k-06.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakataura kuti nei ihafu, kwete yakazara kana hapana here?

k-07.title: Chikumbiro chimwe chete, vateereri vaviri
k-07.goal: Tonga kuti chikumbiro chipi kuna purofesa murairo panzvimbo yechikumbiro chakanyorovedzwa, wobva wanyora chikumbiro chimwe chete kuna purofesa nekushamwari yepedyo.
k-07.material: Wakarwara ndokushaya kirasi yeChipiri. Unoda slides dzehurukuro. Uchakumbira purofesa wako nemeseji, uyewo kumunhu wekirasi ari shamwari yepedyo uye wezera rimwe chete.
k-07.thinking.2: Kunyora patsva zvirevo zvakafanana kumuteereri akasiyana
k-07.s.s1.prompt: Meseji ipi HAISI yakakodzera kutumira kuna purofesa?
k-07.s.s1.hint.0: Dzose ina dzepamutemo muzwi, saka enzanisa chimwe chinhu: meseji yega yega iri kukumbira here kana kuraira?
k-07.s.s1.hint.1: Fungidzira purofesa ari kuverenga meseji yega yega: ipi inonzwika semurairo?
k-07.s.s1.r.a: Iyi yakakodzera: '-(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요?' mubvunzo wakanyorovedzwa unosiya purofesa nenzvimbo yekuti kwete.
k-07.s.s1.r.c: Iyi yakakodzera: inobvunza kuti zvinogoneka here panzvimbo yekuudza purofesa kuti aite chimwe chinhu.
k-07.s.s1.r.d: Iyi yakakodzera: '-(으)시면 감사하겠습니다' nzira yepamutemo yakajairika yekukumbira.
k-07.s.s1.explain: b inoudza purofesa zvekuita ('보내세요') uye inowedzera nguva yekupedzisira ('오늘 안에 꼭'); murairo. Dzimwe dzinokumbira, dzichisiya purofesa akasununguka kupindura.
k-07.s.s2.prompt: Nyora meseji yako kuna purofesa uchikumbira slides. Taura kuti nei wakashaya kirasi.
k-07.s.s2.hint.1: Shandisa chimiro chemubvunzo sa '-(으)ㄹ 수 있을까요?' kunyorovedza.
k-07.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Chikumbiro chakanyorovedzwa uye hachisi murairo here?
k-07.s.s3.prompt: Zvino kumbira shamwari yako yepedyo (zera rimwe chete, unoshandisa 반말) chinhu chimwe chete.
k-07.s.s3.hint.0: Pfupisa mutsara wobva wawupedzisa zvisina mutemo.
k-07.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Izvi zvinonzwika sekutaura neshamwari uye kwete purofesa here?

k-08.title: Kukoka kwakanga kusiri kukoka
k-08.goal: Tsvaga mutsara apo kukwazisa kwakatorwa sekukoka chaiko, tsanangura maitiro emuvakidzani, uye uruamise mhinduro.
k-08.material:
'Unosangana nemuvakidzani muelevator. Munoyambuka mamwe nguva asi hamusi padyo.

Hurukuro:'
k-08.s.s1.prompt: Hurukuro yakava yakaoma. Sarudza mutsara uri chikamu chechikonzero: chirevo chinogona kuverengwa nenzira mbiri, mhinduro inoishandura kuita hurongwa, kana kuteverwa kunomanikidza hurongwa zvakare.
k-08.s.s1.hint.0: Tsvaga mutsara wekutanga apo mumwe munhu anova chaiye kupfuura mumwe.
k-08.s.s1.hint.1: Bvunza: pane nguva kana nzvimbo mumutsara wemuvakidzani pachake here?
k-08.s.s1.explain: '언제 밥 한번 먹어요' (mutsara 3) kazhinji chirevo chinopedzisa chine hushamwari, sa 'let's get lunch sometime'. Mutsara 4 unochitora sehurongwa chaiwo ndokuisa zuva. Kukahadzika kwemuvakidzani (…, 글쎄요, 나중에) kunoratidza kumanikidza. Mutsara 6 ('그럼 다음 주는요? 몇 시가 좋아요?') unomanikidza hurongwa zvakare mushure mekunge muvakidzani akahadzika.
k-08.s.s2.hint.0: Pane nguva kana nzvimbo mumutsara wemuvakidzani here?
k-08.s.s2.hint.1: Funga kuti vanhu vanopedzisa sei hurukuro pfupi muelevator.
k-08.s.s2.o.a: Kutaura 'let's eat sometime' kwaiva chirevo chine hushamwari, uye zuva rakasimbiswa rinonzwika sekumanikidza.
k-08.s.s2.o.b: Muvakidzani haakudi uye anoda kuti uende.
k-08.s.s2.r.b: Hapana muhurukuro chinotaura izvozvo. Muvakidzani anoramba aine mutsa nguva dzose.
k-08.s.s2.o.c: Muvakidzani ane basa vhiki ino chete.
k-08.s.s2.r.c: Zvinogoneka, asi muvakidzani aida chaizvo kusangana aizokurudzira rimwe zuva; zwi rekukahadzika, risingasungiri rinokodzera kukwazisa kwemutsa zvakanyanya.
k-08.s.s2.explain: Mazwi akafanana anogona kuva kukoka chaiko kana kukwazisa kwemutsa. Zwi nenyaya (kusava padyo, muelevator, pasina nguva yakataurwa) zvinoratidza kukwazisa kwemutsa pano.
k-08.s.s2.acc.0: Zvinogona kuva zvechokwadi kuti muvakidzani ane basa, asi zwi rekukahadzika rinotsanangurwa zvakanaka nekukwazisa kwemutsa.
k-08.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mhinduro iri nani ku'네. 언제 밥 한번 먹어요.' ine hushamwari asi isingaisi zuva.
k-08.s.s3.hint.0: Bvuma nenzira yakazara pasina kutumidza zuva kana nguva.
k-08.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Mhinduro yangu inosiya muvakidzani akasununguka kuti ati ehe gare gare here?

k-09.title: Inogona kubuda manheru ano here?
k-09.goal: Verenga chizivisiro chekumba chine rondedzero yakafanana netafura, sarudza chokwadi chisipo chinochinja mhinduro, tarisa mhinduro yakanyorwa nechizivisiro, uye unyore mhinduro yakazara kumuvakidzani mutsva.
k-09.s.s1.prompt: Kupa mhinduro IMWE chaiyo ku 'Can I put these out tonight?', mubvunzo upi waunofanira kubvunza muvakidzani kutanga?
k-09.s.s1.hint.0: Pfuura nechinhu chega chega (박스, 소파, 페트병) wobva wabvunza: mhinduro yemanheru ano yakajeka kare here?
k-09.s.s1.hint.1: Chinhu chipi mhinduro yacho inoenderana nechidimbu chisina kupiwa nemuvakidzani?
k-09.s.s1.r.b: Chero mhinduro ipi, sofa haigoni kubuda manheru ano (kuunganidza kuri neChina). Unogona kukurudzira kuzivisa pasina kubvunza.
k-09.s.s1.r.d: Mabhodhoro anogona kubuda manheru ano zvakadaro; unogona kungoudza muvakidzani kuabvisa zvirimo ndokuashambidza.
k-09.s.s1.explain: Mapepa anobuda neChipiri (manheru ano zvakanaka), asi Styrofoam ndeyeChitatu (kwete manheru ano). '박스' woga haatauri kuti ndeapi. Unogona zvakare kupindura zviitiko zvose panguva imwe chete, asi ichi ndicho chokwadi chete chinochinja mhinduro; sofa 'kwete' nenzira ipi neipi.
k-09.s.s2.prompt: Mhinduro yekutanga yakanyorwa kubva pachizivisiro. Sarudza mutsara usina kururama.
k-09.s.s2.hint.0: Tarisa mutsara wega wega nemutsara unoenderana wetafura.
k-09.s.s2.hint.1: Tarisa mutsara we 대형 폐기물: riini uye sei?
k-09.s.s2.explain: Marara makuru (소파) anofanira kuzivisirwa kutanga uye kuiswa pazuva rekuunganidza, neChina pamberi pe7 a.m., nesitika yakanamirwa. Haagone kubuda manheru ano.
k-09.s.s3.prompt: Nyora mhinduro kumuvakidzani wako mutsva (kutaura kwemutsa) inovhara zvinhu zvose zvitatu.
k-09.s.s3.hint.0: Tora zvinhu chimwe nechimwe: 페트병, 박스, 소파.
k-09.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ndakapindura chinhu chimwe nechimwe chezvitatu here?
k-09.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Ndakapa mamiriro ebhokisi panzvimbo yekufungidzira here?
k-09.s.s3.selfAssess.2: Inzwi rangu rine ushamwari kumuvakidzani mutsva here?
k-09.s.s3.selfAssess.3: Ndakataura kuti sofa inofanira kuzivisirwa hofisi kutanga uye ive nesitika here?

k-11.title: Kuramba kuvhunzira kuviri
k-11.goal: Sarudza kuramba kunogamuchirika kumukuru, wobva wanyora kuramba kumukuru nekumwe kwakasiyana kumushandi ari pamwero mumwechete.
k-11.material:
Nhasi une nguva yekusangana yakasiyana. Kudaidzwa kuviri kunosvika.

팀장님: "오늘 저녁에 다 같이 회식하려고 하는데, 시간 되는 사람은 같이 가요."
입사 동기 (mushandi akapinda panguva imwechete newe, shamwari yepedyo): "오늘 퇴근하고 치킨 먹을래?"
k-11.thinking.2: Kunyora patsva kuramba kumwechete kumuteereri mumwe
k-11.s.s1.prompt: Kuramba kupi kwaungatumira kuna 팀장님? Sarudza zvese zvinokodzera mamiriro.
k-11.s.s1.hint.0: Pameseji imwe neimwe, cherekedza kana ichikumbira ruregerero kana kuratidza kuzvidemba, ichipa chikonzero, uye ichipfavisa nechimwe sa '-ㄹ 것 같습니다'.
k-11.s.s1.hint.1: Sarudza meseji dzose dzinoita zvinhu zviviri kana kupfuura nenzira iyo mukuru angagamuchira.
k-11.s.s1.r.a: Inokodzera (kukumbira ruregerero, chikonzero, chinopfavisa). Haisi yega inokodzera, saka tarisa nesarudzo dzimwe.
k-11.s.s1.r.b: Kupera kwepamutemo, asi meseji i chirevo chisina chinhu: hapana kukumbira ruregerero, hapana kuzvidemba uye hapana kupfavisa ('안 갑니다' i 'handiendi' yakajeka), izvo zvakashata kumukuru.
k-11.s.s1.r.c: Inokodzera (kuzvidemba, chikonzero, pamutemo). Haisi yega inokodzera, saka tarisa nesarudzo dzimwe.
k-11.s.s1.r.d: Inokodzera (chikonzero, chinopfavisa, chipikirwa chenguva inotevera). Haisi yega inokodzera, saka tarisa nesarudzo dzimwe.
k-11.s.s1.explain: a ne c dzinokumbira ruregerero kana kuratidza kuzvidemba ('죄송하지만', '아쉽지만'), dzinopa chikonzero uye dzinopfavisa kuramba. d inopa chikonzero, inopfavisa ne '못 갈 것 같습니다' uye inopikira nguva inotevera. b inongotaura kuramba kwakajeka ('안 갑니다') saka inonzwika yakashata kunyangwe kupera kuri kwepamutemo.
k-11.s.s1.acc.0: Zvose zvinokodzera; d inowedzerawo chipikirwa chenguva inotevera, saka kusarudza dzose nhatu i mhinduro yakakwana.
k-11.s.s2.prompt: Nyora kuramba kwako kuna 팀장님. Shandisa kutaura kunoremekedza/kwepamutemo, kupfavise, ipa chikonzero uye utaure nguva inotevera.
k-11.s.s2.hint.0: Tanga nekukumbira ruregerero kana kutenda, wobva wapa chikonzero.
k-11.s.s2.selfAssess.0: 팀장님 aizonzwa achiremekedzwa kwete kurambwa here?
k-11.s.s3.prompt: Zvino ramba kudaidzwa kwe 동기 kuchikuku kuchikafu nekutaura kwakajairika. Chengeta ushamwari uye ukurudzire imwe nguva.
k-11.s.s3.hint.0: Pfupisa mutsara uye bvisa kupera kwepamutemo.
k-11.s.s3.hint.1: Taura kuti ndine tsitsi, chikonzero, uye 'nguva inotevera'.
k-11.s.s3.selfAssess.1: Kuramba kwakajeka uye kune ushamwari here?
